description: VR mod for FEZ (Steam): the game as a 3D diorama in a SteamVR headset, with motion controllers.
notes: FEZ-VR is installed next to FEZ.exe in your FEZ folder (found through Steam). FEZ's own files are not changed.
Play from Steam's normal 'FEZ' entry: it starts in VR, and is listed in SteamVR's VR library tab after Steam next restarts.
Upgrading from 0.1.0: remove the old 'FEZ VR' entry from your Steam library (right-click > Manage > Remove non-Steam game).
Game in an unusual place? Set the FEZVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'FEZ-VR setup failed (see the log above).' }
# On update the new version's installer simply installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
